title: refactor(Development): share exists_tateIsoO_of_given between TateTranslSys and PTransDeep
body:
Moves the generalized Hecke-translate Tate isomorphism construction `exists_tateIsoO_of_given` into `ExistsTateSimilitudeHeckeTranslateLatticeSystem.lean`, delegates `exists_tateIsoO_transl_sys` to it, and removes the duplicated `HodgeTateWeilLocal` clump member from `PTransDeep.lean`.

Declarations changed:
- Added `GlobalTheory.UPel.HT.HeckeAd.TateTranslSys.exists_tateIsoO_of_given` in `ExistsTateSimilitudeHeckeTranslateLatticeSystem.lean` and delegated `GlobalTheory.UPel.HT.HeckeAd.TateTranslSys.exists_tateIsoO_transl_sys` to it.
- Removed the duplicate `GlobalTheory.UPel.HT.HeckeAd.TateTranslAt.exists_tateIsoO_of_given` (clump member `HodgeTateWeilLocal`) from `PTransDeep.lean` and updated `UpperTheory.Gal.G3.pTransDeep` to call `GlobalTheory.UPel.HT.HeckeAd.TateTranslSys.exists_tateIsoO_of_given`.
